description: Brings the Relaydeck inbox to the agent: when a session starts, with each prompt, before a stop, and while the agent waits.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/inbox.sh"; if [ -r "$f" ]; then sh "$f" claude start; fi
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/inbox.sh"; if [ -r "$f" ]; then sh "$f" claude watch; fi
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/inbox.sh"; if [ -r "$f" ]; then sh "$f" claude prompt; fi
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/inbox.sh"; if [ -r "$f" ]; then sh "$f" claude stop; fi
f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/inbox.sh"; if [ -r "$f" ]; then sh "$f" claude watch; fi
